output.title: Exporting reports to PDF (macOS)
output.content: On macOS, the in-app 'Export to PDF' button can crash the app on some versions. Workaround: use File > Print, then choose 'Save as PDF' from the system print dialog instead of the in-app export button. A permanent fix is planned but not yet released.

output.title: Supported browsers
output.content: The web app officially supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. Internet Explorer is not supported. Some layout issues may appear on unsupported browsers.

output.title: Data export / GDPR requests
output.content: To request a full export of your account data for GDPR or personal record-keeping purposes, go to Account Settings > Privacy > Request Data Export. The export is prepared within 30 days and sent as a download link to your account email.

**Draft Reply:**

Thank you for reporting this issue. We're aware of a PDF export crash problem that's affecting multiple users, and I appreciate you letting us know you're experiencing it on Windows 11 as well.

While our current documentation focuses on a macOS workaround, your report suggests this issue may be broader. Here's what I can offer:

**Immediate workaround:**
Try using **File > Print** and then select **Save as PDF** from the system print dialog instead of using the in-app export button. This may help you get around the crash while we work on a permanent fix.

**Next steps:**
Since you're on Windows and experiencing this crash, it would be helpful for our development team to understand the scope of this issue across platforms. Could you provide:
- Any error messages you see when the crash occurs
- Which version of the app you're running
- Whether the Print > Save as PDF workaround works for you on Windows

A permanent fix is planned, but I don't have a specific timeline to share at this moment. I'll ensure this is escalated to our team so we can investigate the Windows-specific behavior.

---
